inputs.text: This is exactly how they make a managed outcome look inevitable: call the APC’s direction ahead of the 2027 elections an “accident,” and the people benefiting from it disappear from view. The wealthy keep their influence while ordinary people are edged out, then democracy is displayed on paper as if that settles the matter. The real decisions are being made out of sight, and the “accident” story is there to keep people from asking who arranged things this way.
